scope: Compare only the archived positions of model 1, entity 1, label chains A/B/C.
measurement: common_backbone selects a residue only when all of N, CA, C and O are observed in all three chains. Its denominator is the union of observed backbone residue positions in these chains. Retain source digest, mask and actual numerator and denominator.
interpretation: The prespecified completeness threshold for continuing this comparison is three fifths of the observed positions. A zero denominator or unreadable input leaves applicability undetermined. A partial file cannot establish independent biological sampling.
followup: Determine if a proposed descriptive comparison of complete shared backbone positions with the archived reference can proceed.
